name: Bangalore Refinery Pvt Ltd.,
india_angle: Bangalore Refinery Pvt Ltd. operates a state-of-the-art facility in Bengaluru, India, focusing on precious metal refining and recovery.
summary: Bangalore Refinery Pvt Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of precious metal-based electroplating chemicals and offers metal refining and recovery solutions. Their products are crucial for advanced packaging and electronics manufacturing, providing high-quality materials that enhance the performance of semiconductor components.
